text:
kevin_se: Heads-up — Gamma Corp POC timeline. Need quick async check on integration deliverables + owners. Proposed milestones:
- Week 1: data ingestion & mapping
- Week 2: SAML + VPC peering
- Week 3: perf baseline (dedicated)
- Week 4: signoff + handoff
Anyone blocked or wants to own specific items?

jason_eng: I can own SAML + VPC peering. Need VPN creds from Gamma and a network contact. Also will need their CIDR for peering rules. Who's owning the CRM connector work?

maria_sales: I’ll ask Gamma for the VPN creds and network contact — pinged them in the tracker, expect reply tomorrow morning PST. CRM connector currently unassigned; cc @anika_pm for success criteria on data mapping.

anika_pm: Success criteria to confirm:
- Functional: records synced without schema errors for 1000 sample rows
- Performance: p99 latency < 500ms at 1k qps baseline for generate call
- Quality: embeddings similarity within 2% of baseline model
- Compliance: no PII exfil, Security sign-off on data flows
I’ll add these to the test plan.

jason_eng: For perf baseline I need the model variant and prompt set. Kevin, can you confirm model and share a minimal prompt file? Also prefer to run baseline on Dedicated pool (prod-dedicated-1).

kevin_se: Confirmed: we'll use `redwood-7b-quant` for the trial. Sample prompt set below (small excerpt) — use as canonical baseline: 
```
{"prompts": [
  "Summarize this ticket in two lines:",
  "Extract entities and map to CRM fields:",
  "Generate recommended next action:"
]}
```
Also recommend prefix caching enabled and token limit = 1024. I can own CRM connector shim + sample mapping.

sofia_support: We have capacity on `prod-dedicated-1`. Can reserve 2x A100 equivalents for the POC window. Need an IT ticket for VPC peering and firewall rules (egress to model endpoint). How many tokens/sec do you expect for the baseline?

maria_sales: Gamma asked to push the data ingestion window by +7 days (they need more time to anonymize). Proposed new timeline shifts everything by one week. Any objections?

jason_eng: That’s fine from eng — shifting is ok but pushes the perf test start. Please confirm by EOD so I can update the sprint.

anika_pm: I’ll update the Confluence plan and ownership matrix. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/POC/pages/Gamma+Corp+Trial (will add dates + acceptance).

kevin_se: I’ll deliver the CRM connector shim + mapping samples by Wednesday EOD. If Gamma provides sample CSVs earlier I’ll start mapping sooner. :thumbsup:

jason_eng: Code review ping — PR #432 (SAML + VPC) needs review from @kevin_se and @sofia_support. Small nginx + env var changes.

sofia_support: On it, will review PR today and file the IT peering ticket once we have Gamma CIDR.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment to `prod-dedicated-1` for Thursday 10:00 UTC (non-prod window). Reminder: run smoke tests after deploy and tag results in the tracker.

kevin_se: One more ask — Gamma wants an explicit eviction/fallback policy if dedicated capacity is saturated. We should propose a policy (fallback to hosted L3 model variant + throttling) in the runbook. Who owns the runbook updates?

anika_pm: I’ll own the runbook edits and add the fallback policy text. Assigning to @jason_eng for the implementation notes.

maria_sales: I'll confirm the VPN creds + CIDR today and update the tracker.

jason_eng: Great — summary for owners:
- Data ingestion + mapping: kevin_se
- SAML + VPC: jason_eng
- Infra/quotas + PR review: sofia_support
- Success criteria + runbook: anika_pm
- Sales liaison + creds: maria_sales
If anyone needs to swap, speak now.

kevin_se: All good here. I’ll post the CRM sample mapping in this thread when ready.

sofia_support: Will post IT ticket link once created.

maria_sales: Confirmed — will update by EOD.
